packs.name: RealVisXL V5.0 Lightning (SDXL Q4_K)
packs.description: SDXL model focused on realistic portraits and photography. Lightning distillation supports short sampling schedules. Requires substantial RAM; generation speed depends on device hardware and resolution.

packs.name: DreamShaper 8 LCM (fast offline)
packs.description: Fast offline images with LCM: 384×384, 6 steps (4 for speed), CFG 1. English prompts recommended. Installs from a 2.13 GB checkpoint and prepares a 1.33 GB model bundle. Requires at least 6 GB usable physical RAM and 3.7 GB free storage during installation. CPU only; negative prompts are inactive at CFG 1. Runtime license: non-commercial.
